name: safesweep
description: Premium, offline-first, and safety-focused Windows desktop utility.

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:sidecar
scripts.preelectron:dev: powershell -Command "$p = netstat -ano | Select-String ':5173\s' | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\s+')[-1] } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($p) { taskkill /PID $p /F 2>$null }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300"
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently --prefix none "npm run dev --silent" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron --no-deprecation ."

author: Antigravity
